notes:
## Changes

- **Make contact sheets.** Right-click a folder and choose Make contact sheets, or right-click a scene for one sheet. Each sheet is a grid of pictures from across the video (4 across and 7 down to start with), under a header with the file name, folder, length, size, resolution and the video and sound formats, with the time on each picture. You can pick the grid, the width and what the header shows.
- **An overview sheet for the folder**, if you tick it: one picture per scene with its name, length and size.
- The sheets go into a folder you choose, never next to your videos, and your videos are only read. Scenes on drives that aren't connected are listed but can't be ticked. You can keep using Video Shelf while it works, and Cancel keeps the sheets already made.
linuxNotes:
First Linux preview of Video Shelf: the whole app on Ubuntu and similar systems (.deb). It uses the same catalogue as the Windows app.

Install with:

    sudo apt install ./videoshelf_0.12.0_amd64.deb
